sub_sector.value: Florida commercial residential catastrophe-exposed property insurance

financial_business_type.detail: Admitted carrier writing Florida condo, HOA, apartment and assisted living property through MGAs.

revenue_driver.detail: Premiums on commercial residential property policies, plus investment income on float.

customer_type.detail: Condo and homeowner associations, apartment owners and assisted living operators, reached via agents and MGAs.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Carries underwriting risk with own retention, backed by reinsurance, catastrophe fund and catastrophe bonds.
